primary_goals: Snatch 120 kg at the national qualifier in 8 weeks
Clean and jerk 150 kg at the same meet
secondary_goals: Keep front squat strength while sharpening the lifts
maintenance_goals: Maintain back squat and pulling strength

Snatch: 112 kg best in training, 108 kg at last meet
Clean and jerk: 141 kg best in training, 137 kg at last meet
Front Squat: 165 kg x 1
Back Squat: 195 kg x 1
Snatch Pull: 130 kg x 3

weightlifter_peak.notes: National qualifier is in 8 weeks. This is a 4-week block covering weeks 1 to 4 of that 8-week runway, so it is a build block and not the peak. Competition lifts take priority over squat numbers. Five sessions per week, 100 minutes each. Classic lifts must be trained heavy and often; accessories exist only to serve them.

secondary_goals: Hold my strength through camp without adding fatigue
maintenance_goals: Maintain the strength and power I already have

pain.description: Right knee ache after heavy bilateral squatting
pain.tolerated_movements: Trap bar deadlift, split squats, sled pushes, hip thrusts and all upper body are comfortable. Heavy back squat is not.

mma_fight_camp.notes: Fight is in 3 weeks, so this block runs into fight week. Sport is the priority and strength work exists only to keep what he has without stealing recovery. Two gym sessions of 40 minutes, Tuesday and Friday, both after MMA. Weight cut begins in the final week. Do not add conditioning: he already trains seven times a week.
